No preamble, no restating the task, no summary of what you did or are about to do. Code, commands and tool arguments are as long as they need to be; everything else is short.
config._about: Overnight 2026-09-24/25: the rotation (Nanbeige left out: slow, and it contributed nothing), 10 turns per session, minimal feedback. Attempts are effectively unlimited; --deadline ends the run. Coding steps get bash + edit (from iteration 2). Retries start from the attempt with the most passing tests so far, told only its verdict; from the step's start, with no feedback, until some test passes (iteration 3 used plain reset; best from iteration 4). Feedback level focus (from iteration 5, resumed): the verdict plus the name of one failing test. Then feedback level failures (iteration 5, second resume): one line per failing test with its last error line, as the comparison with focus.
